notes.title: The Headless Horseman returns for revenge and 100 gold.
notes.content:
A young and promising knight was slain the first night the evil hamster horde appeared.  The Templars believe he is the cause of the curse across the land but no one can be certain.  His disembodied head floats behind him shrieking and moaning as he uses his severed arm to beat his opponents.  The appearance of this ghoul has caught the attention of the seclusive warlock Mizrah.  The warlock is traveling to the proving grounds to talk with the King.  What is his scheme?

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Headless is 100 gold to unlock
[*]Warlock is 2000 gold to unlock
[*]Raised spawn point of player 1 in sneaky forest to address random falling through world issue.
[*]Enabled the resolution dialog to allow users to modify settings and keybinding.
[/list]

[b]Known issues:[/b]
Keybinding input called "Hack".  This only works in internal builds.  Sooooooo.... you'll try to mess with it anyways. <glares at you>

notes.title: The Samurai offers his blade for 1 Gold
notes.content:
A devastating attack on Ninjy Village left it all but completely destroyed.  Their greatest swordman Takeda Hideyoshi was left badly injured and his family dead.   Rumors swirl about the eastern lands that his blade seeks vengence against the curse.  A journey that has lead him to the shrine of the legendary warrior Miyamoto Musashi filling his body with a strange power.  Now the samurai heads west to answer the call to the King for a single gold coin.

As the samurai get closer and closer to the castle, he feels a strange presense nearby.  A cursed soul moaning for the loss of ... his head?

Find him and other knights at the Proving Grounds.

Patch Notes:
- Fixed potion location in non-combat HUD
- Reduced the prices for a couple of special knights (for a limited time)

notes.title: Patch: Difficulty and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello fellow hamster slayers.  There is a new build available that I hope addresses some player feedback.

- Lowered cost of unlocking some knights
- Lower star requirement for all location unlocks
- Lowered gold requirement for tier 2 melee and ranged weapons
-- ranged weapon 20g -> 10g
-- melee weapon 30g ->25g
- Increased the auto-attack rate from 0.2secs to 0.125secs.  This should help with input fatigue.
- Unlocking upgrade will now grant upgrade without needing to touch trigger
- Added message to map screen to clearly state the stars required to advance.
- Treasury is available after talking to king
- Pressing "A" or "Y" button will attempt to buy locked knight.
- Tutorial dumps you back into castle
- Fixed bug where tutorial revealed grassy plains before it revealed happy valley
- Fixed spelling error in the zoo.
